scripts.pack: npm run server && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run server && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run server -- --platform=win32 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run server -- --platform=darwin && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run server -- --platform=linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
